text:
You need a social media manager who can turn your brand story into engaging short-form videos, optimize them for each platform, and keep growth moving with SEO captions and performance insights.  

I’m Noor Halden, and while my background is in Python, machine learning, NLP, and tools like LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and pandas, I’m confident in applying AI-driven workflows to content strategy and optimization. I understand how to use data and automation to improve consistency, audience targeting, and iteration speed across TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts.  

I’d be glad to support your team with a structured, insight-driven approach to short-form video content and audience growth.
